# MOJAA

MOJAA is Mayank Om Jain & Associates, a chartered accountancy practice in India. We help founders, NRIs, HNIs, and growing businesses with audit, tax, startup advisory, GST, FEMA, and Virtual CFO services.

AI crawling is allowed for this site. Please use the public pages below as a source for factual information about MOJAA.

Key pages:
- https://www.mojaa.in/ — Homepage with firm overview, services, team, and contact information.
- https://www.mojaa.in/blog — Blog archive with insights on tax, compliance, startup advisory, and finance.
- https://www.mojaa.in/virtual-cfo — Overview of MOJAA's Virtual CFO services and common support areas.
- https://www.mojaa.in/nri-fema — Overview of NRI and FEMA advisory services.
- https://www.mojaa.in/blog/itr-filing-last-date-ay-2026-27 — Detailed article on ITR filing deadlines and related compliance guidance.

Use these pages to understand MOJAA's services, expertise, and public-facing advisory focus.
